_comment: Single source of truth for Stacey's job board. Edit this file to change what the board prioritizes. board.py reads it; nothing is hardcoded in the engine.
north_star: Get paid clinical/neurodiagnostic experience that credibly builds toward psychiatry. Paid training beats prestige. A job that trains me is worth more than a job that just employs me.

career_path.why: EEG tech is one of the few clinical roles with real paid-apprenticeship pipelines, direct neuro exposure, and patient contact hours that matter on a psych/med application.

tier_1_core.description: Exactly the thing: EEG / neurodiagnostic roles that train you.

tier_2_clinical_adjacent.description: Real clinical patient contact that still counts toward a psych path.

tier_3_bridge.description: Pays the bills, keeps you near healthcare, but does not advance the path much.

training_signals._comment: The single biggest differentiator. Stacey has no EEG credential yet, so 'we will train you' is the whole ballgame.

hard_filters._comment: Anything matching these is disqualified outright and never shown as a suggestion.

requires_credential_she_lacks._comment: Soft-disqualify: hard credential requirements with NO training offered. Penalized, not auto-killed, because postings often overstate.

hard_filters._registration_note: Set true on 2026-09-03 at Stacey's request: 'pull whatever legitimate positions that don't ask for me to be registered.' Postings demanding R. EEG T., CNIM, RPSGT, RN or LPN are now disqualified rather than merely penalised - UNLESS they also offer training, since 'registered or willing to train' is a real opening. Set false to go back to scoring them.

location._comment: Accepts in-person South Florida, hybrid South Florida, and fully remote anywhere in the US.
location._metro_note: Expanded 2026-09-03. Oakland Park (about 15 minutes from Hollywood) was scoring as 'likely a long commute' because only the larger cities were listed. Any Broward or north Miami-Dade municipality inside the 45-minute band belongs here.

schedule.notes: Full-time preferred for benefits, but part-time is genuinely fine if the training is real. Night/weekend EEG shifts are acceptable and often the easiest way in.

compensation._comment: Soft preference, not a filter. An apprenticeship at 18/hr that certifies her beats a 24/hr dead-end.
compensation.note: Do not disqualify a Tier 1 apprenticeship for low pay. Flag it, don't kill it.

freshness._comment: Stale postings are usually already filled. Decay hard after two weeks.
freshness._note: Archive window widened to 120 days on 2026-09-03 after real Indeed data showed CRO and hospital reqs stay posted for months. Decay still ranks anything over 30 days near the bottom.
freshness._freshness_note: ok_days raised from 14 to 21 on 2026-09-03. Hospital system and CRO requisitions routinely stay open three weeks or more; a 15-day-old Jackson Health req was losing 65% of its freshness points and dropping below newer, weaker listings.

employers_of_interest._comment: South Florida systems that actually run EEG/neurodiagnostic departments or known training pipelines. Bonus points, not a filter.
employers_of_interest.personal_context: Nicklaus Children's was an open lead from her Notion planning page. Dr. Robinson at Nova Southeastern was a possible temporary graduate-assistant contact.

search_queries._comment: Feed these to Indeed. Ordered by expected value.

scoring._comment: Total possible is normalized to 0-100 in board.py. Weights above are relative contributions.

priority_bands.name: APPLY NOW
priority_bands.action: Apply today. This is the shape of job the whole board exists to find.

priority_bands.name: STRONG
priority_bands.action: Apply this week. Worth a tailored resume line.

priority_bands.name: WORTH A LOOK
priority_bands.action: Apply if you have energy left. Low cost, low certainty.

priority_bands.name: BACKUP
priority_bands.action: Only if the pipeline dries up.

priority_bands.name: SKIP
priority_bands.action: Not worth your time. Logged so we don't re-surface it.

scoring._adhd_note: Never show more than 10. A wall of 60 listings is the same as zero listings. Top 3 get the detail; the rest are one line each.

differentiators._comment: Real, verifiable advantages from her CV. Score a listing UP when the posting asks for one of these.

haitian_creole_advanced.why: Advanced Haitian Creole + intermediate Spanish/French. In Broward/Miami-Dade hospitals this is a genuine hiring edge, not a nice-to-have. Memorial, Jackson, Broward Health all serve large Creole-speaking patient populations.

neuroscience_degree.why: BS Neuroscience + Psychology (dual major). Most EEG apprenticeship postings ask for an associate's or 'science coursework'. She over-qualifies on paper.

psychiatric_exposure.why: Miami Summer Scholars psychiatry track at Jackson Behavioral Hospital: neuropsych assessments, therapeutic interviewing, shadowed psychiatrists in outpatient clinics.

patient_contact_hours.why: 70 documented shadowing hours + 2 yrs serving elderly residents at FiveStar Premier retirement home. Real patient-facing hours, not theoretical.

research_and_data.why: Two RA positions (one paid), PCR/ELISA/cell culture, RStudio, systematic literature review in Excel. Strong for clinical research coordinator roles.

bls_certified.why: Holds a current BLS/CPR card (confirmed 2026-09-03). When a posting names it as a requirement she clears it outright, which is exactly the kind of checkbox that gets an entry-level clinical application auto-filtered.
